units.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net reads and writes MSG and EML email formats. It converts messages between MSG and EML representations and preserves message content such as subject, sender, recipients, and attachments. It inspects the internal structure of MSG files using the CFB format reader. It operates on .NET 8.0 and has no external dependencies.
It reads MSG files from streams or files using MapiMessage.FromStream and writes them back with Save, exposing the Subject property and other message fields directly.
It creates new messages with MapiMessage.Create, sets SenderName and SenderEmailAddress, adds recipients and attachments, and saves the result to a file.
It converts EML files to MSG using MapiMessage.LoadFromEml and back to EML with SaveToEml, implementing both directions natively without external dependencies.
It opens CFB containers from files with CfbReader.FromFile, reports sector size and directory entry count, and iterates the directory tree with IterTree.
It accesses arbitrary MAPI properties on message objects using SetProperty and GetPropertyValue, beyond the strongly-typed properties exposed directly by MapiMessage.
It attaches recipients with AddRecipient and files with AddAttachment, including nested embedded messages via AddEmbeddedMessageAttachment.
This example reads a MSG file and prints its subject line using Aspose.Email.Foss version 26.7.0 targeting net8.0.
The following examples demonstrate creating and saving MSG messages, converting EML to MSG, and inspecting the CFB structure of MSG files.
Create and save an MSG message with sender, recipient, and attachment.
Convert an EML file to MSG and back to EML.
Inspect the CFB container structure of a MSG file.

Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net provides high-level message handling through Aspose.Email.Foss.Msg.MapiMessage and lower-level access via Aspose.Email.Foss.Cfb.CfbReader and Aspose.Email.Foss.Msg.MsgReader. MapiMessage serves as the primary entry point for creating, editing, and converting messages, while CfbReader and MsgReader expose direct access to the underlying storage formats.

Aspose.Email.Foss.Msg.MapiMessage supports creating messages from scratch with Create, loading from files or streams with FromFile and FromStream, and converting to EML format with SaveToEml; it also provides methods like AddRecipient, AddAttachment, and AddEmbeddedMessageAttachment for building message content, along with property access through SetProperty and GetPropertyValue. Aspose.Email.Foss.Cfb.CfbReader enables reading Compound File Binary structures through FromFile and FromStream constructors, offering iteration over storages and streams via IterStorages, IterStreams, and IterTree, plus direct access to entries and stream data through GetEntry and GetStreamData. Aspose.Email.Foss.Msg.MsgReader provides strict parsing of MSG files with FromFile and FromStream, exposing validation issues through its ValidationIssues property. Aspose.Email.Foss.Cfb.CfbWriter offers static methods ToBytes and WriteFile to serialize CfbDocument instances to bytes or files. Aspose.Email.Foss.Msg.MsgStorageRole defines the role of MSG storage objects within the message hierarchy.
The getting started guide covers installation, walkthroughs, and feature guides for this library.
The how-to guides and FAQ provide task-focused answers for common MSG, CFB, and EML questions.
The full API reference offers the complete, browsable reference for all 29 public types.
The public API summary lists the repository's own stable-namespace and primary-type list.
The changelog documents the release history.
Users can open issues on GitHub for bug reports or feature requests.

Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net reads and writes local email files in formats supported by the Aspose.Email.Foss package version 26.7.0 for net8.0, without connecting to mail servers or providing dedicated APIs for calendar or TNEF content.
The library does not support IMAP, SMTP, or POP3 protocols and does not connect to mail servers, as it operates on local files only.
Transport Neutral Encapsulation Format files, commonly named winmail.dat, are not parsed or generated.
Calendar or appointment support is not provided; calendar-specific MAPI properties can be accessed generically via SetProperty() or GetPropertyValue() only.
The package requires .NET 8.0 or later and does not support the classic .NET Framework (4.x).

Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net targets net8.0 and uses the dotnet CLI for building and testing. The test project at tests/Aspose.Email.Foss.Tests/Aspose.Email.Foss.Tests.csproj depends on Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.8.0, xunit 2.5.3, xunit.runner.visualstudio 2.5.3, and coverlet.collector 6.0.0 for running tests and collecting code coverage; these dependencies are not used by the main library project and are never shipped with the published package.

it adds broader format and protocol coverage: direct IMAP/SMTP/POP3 mail-server connectivity, TNEF (winmail.dat) support, calendar and appointment APIs, and classic .NET Framework support alongside this edition's MSG, CFB, and EML processing.
CfbConstants provides constant values used in Compound File Binary format processing.
CfbDocument represents a Compound File Binary structure and provides methods to load it from files, streams, or readers.
CfbException represents errors that occur during Compound File Binary format processing.
CfbNode represents a node in a Compound File Binary structure with properties such as name, class identifier, timestamps, and state bits.
CfbReader provides functionality to read and navigate a Compound File Binary structure, including accessing directory entries, streams, and storage nodes.
CfbStorage represents a storage node in a Compound File Binary structure that can contain child storages and streams.
CfbStream represents a stream node in a Compound File Binary structure that holds binary data.
CfbWriter provides functionality to write a Compound File Binary structure.
DirectoryEntry represents an entry in the directory of a Compound File Binary structure.
DirectoryEntryNameComparer provides a comparer for directory entries based on their names.
Header represents the header information of a Compound File Binary structure.
MapiAttachment represents an attachment in a MAPI message.
MapiMessage represents a MAPI message and provides access to its properties, recipients, and attachments.
MapiProperty represents a single property in a MAPI message.
MapiPropertyCollection represents a collection of MAPI properties.
MapiRecipient represents a recipient in a MAPI message.
MsgConstants provides constant values used in MSG format processing.
MsgDocument represents an MSG format file and provides methods to load it from files, streams, or readers.
MsgException represents errors that occur during MSG format processing.
MsgReader provides functionality to read and navigate an MSG format file.
MsgStorage represents a storage node in an MSG format file.
MsgStorageRole specifies the role of a storage node in an MSG format file.
MsgStream represents a stream node in an MSG format file.
MsgWriter provides functionality to write an MSG format file.
